# Text and Unstructured Data for Data Science

> Turn Arabic and English text into measurements you can defend: clean and redact a corpus, score sparse, embedding and prompted classifiers on one gold set, test a language model as an annotator and correct the estimates its labels feed. SDAIA Academy course DS-306, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 19,714 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Text into clean data](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/slides/day1.md): Profile, normalise, deduplicate and redact 20,000 complaints before any model reads them; sessions: Text as a data source, Preparing Arabic text, Near-duplicates, Redacting personal data; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/slides/day1.html; about 5,320 tokens
- [Day 2: Labels you can trust](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/slides/day2.md): A gold set, chance-corrected agreement and two classifiers compared on the same documents; sessions: Gold sets and agreement, Sparse baselines, Embeddings as features, Comparing classifiers fairly; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/slides/day2.html; about 4,745 tokens
- [Day 3: Language models as instruments](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/slides/day3.md): A prompted open-weight model measured like any other instrument: accuracy, stability, dialect gaps; sessions: Prompted classification, Ask it twice, Dialect gaps, Is the model a good annotator; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/slides/day3.html; about 4,199 tokens
- [Day 4: From documents to tables](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/slides/day4.md): Validated extraction, field-level scores, clusters, and estimates corrected with the human sample; sessions: Schema-constrained extraction, Field-level validation, Structure in text, Errors downstream; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/slides/day4.html; about 3,710 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone: a text measurement defended live](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/slides/capstone.md): Each participant defends a text-measurement pipeline in eight minutes, then re-labels ten documents chosen by the assessor and answers questions; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/slides/capstone.html; about 1,249 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Profile the corpus](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/labs/D1_1_profile.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Normalise Arabic text](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/labs/D1_2_normalise.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Find near-duplicates](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/labs/D1_3_near_duplicates.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Redact and measure misses](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/labs/D1_4_redaction.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Agreement with a partner](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/labs/D2_1_agreement.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: A character n-gram classifier](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/labs/D2_2_sparse.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: An embedding classifier](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/labs/D2_3_embeddings.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Compare classifiers fairly](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/labs/D2_4_paired_bootstrap.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Prompted classification](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/labs/D3_1_prompted.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Ask it twice](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/labs/D3_2_stability.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Dialect gaps](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/labs/D3_3_dialect_gaps.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: A good annotator?](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/labs/D3_4_annotator.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: Six fields, validated](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/labs/D4_1_extraction.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: Field-level validation](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/labs/D4_2_field_validation.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: Structure in text](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/labs/D4_3_clusters.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: Corrected rates](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-306/labs/D4_4_corrected_rates.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
